format: HTML with embedded JavaScript and Ruby code
description: This file is an HTML webpage that includes embedded JavaScript to initialize a CodeMirror editor configured for Ruby mode, and contains sample Ruby source code demonstrating polynomial evaluation functions.

methods.name: polyval
methods.description: Evaluates a polynomial at a given point x using a list of coefficients.

methods.name: readints
methods.description: Reads a line of input, parses it into integer coefficients of a polynomial, and handles special commands like 'quit'.

methods.name: term_to_str
methods.description: Converts a coefficient and exponent into a human-readable string representation of a term.

methods.name: polystr
methods.description: Constructs a formatted string representing a polynomial from a list of coefficients.
